occ.birthday.name: Achaima sal
occ.birthday.headline: Achaima salni hambai
occ.birthday.message: Norokno khakchangma, kaham hamya tei thwngmung bai supungjak bisi wngna bagwi wish khlaio. Norokni joto imang kubui wngthung.
occ.anniversary.name: Kaijakmani bisi kwtal
occ.anniversary.headline: bisi kwtalni hambai
occ.anniversary.message: Norok khoroknwi no langma jora hamjakma, kwrwngwi tongnani tei tongthokma tongnani wish khwlaio. O naithokma salni bagwi hambai.
occ.wedding.name: Kaijakma
occ.wedding.headline: Tongthokma Kaijakmani Langma
occ.wedding.message: Nini wedding ni bagwi belai kheno hambai. Norokni kwthalaimani jora hamjakma, poito tei paiphlaiya tongthokma bai supungjak wngthung.
occ.work-anniversary.name: Samung bisi kwtal
occ.work-anniversary.headline: Samung bisini hambai
occ.work-anniversary.message: Tei kaisa bisini dedication tei kotor samungni bagwi hambai. Team no tubumani jotono hambai.
occ.business-anniversary.name: Business ni bisi kwtal
occ.business-anniversary.headline: Business bisi kwtal ni hambai
occ.business-anniversary.message: Tei kaisa thwngmungni bisini bagwi hambai. Norokni poito tei chubachuni bagwi hambai — omo teibo kwbangma bisini bagwi.
occ.inauguration.name: Dukan / Ophiso Kholokjak
occ.inauguration.headline: Hambai yapharo nini kwtal swkangmungni bagwi
occ.inauguration.message: Grand phuarjakmani bagwi belai kheno hambai. Nini kwtal samung wngkha rangchakni, tormani tei kotor kotor thwngmung tubunai.
occ.congratulations.name: Hambai yapharo
occ.congratulations.headline: Hambai yapharo
occ.congratulations.message: Nini achievementni bagwi belai kheno hambai. Norokni samung tei saktharmung chwng jotono kubui khe inspire khlaio.
occ.thank-you.name: Hambai
occ.thank-you.headline: Hambai
occ.thank-you.message: Norokni poito tei chubachuni bagwi hambai. Chwng kubui khe hambai rwkha norok chini thani tongmani bagwi.
occ.get-well-soon.name: Dakti Kaham Wngdi
occ.get-well-soon.headline: Dakti Kaham Wngdi
occ.get-well-soon.message: Norok dakti dakti hamwi phaina bagwi wish khlaio. Care khaidi tei belai kheno dakti khe kaham khe wngwi phaidi.
occ.housewarming.name: Nok tangmani (griha pravesh)
occ.housewarming.headline: Griha pravesh ni hambai
occ.housewarming.message: Norokni nok kwtalni bagwi hambai. Khakchangma, hamjakma, tongthokma tei hamari bai supungjak wngthung.
occ.new-baby.name: Chwrai Kwtal
occ.new-baby.headline: Kwplaisa, Chwrai
occ.new-baby.message: Norokni khakchangma ni kisa bundle phaimanini bagwi belai kheno hambai. Chwrai no langma jorao hamya wngwi tongna bagwi wish khwlaio.
occ.retirement.name: Retire ni hambai
occ.retirement.headline: Retire ni hambai
occ.retirement.message: Hambai rohorjao kaham khe samung tangmani bagwi. Norokno khakchangma, hamya tei tongthokma kwtal chapter wngna bagwi wish khwlaio.
occ.best-wishes.name: Hamjakma
occ.best-wishes.headline: Hamjakma
occ.best-wishes.message: Norok joto samung tangmani jorao khakchangma, kaham hamya tei thwngmungni bagwi chini belai kheno hambai rohorwi tongo.
occ.new-year.name: Bisi kwtal
occ.new-year.headline: Bisi kwtal ni hambai
occ.new-year.message: O bisi kwtal norokni bagwi kwtal khatungma, kwtal jora tei kwbangma thwngmung tubuthung. Norok tei norokni nukhung no swkangni bisi kaham wngwi tongna bagwi wish khlaio.
occ.republic-day.name: Hasteni Sal
occ.republic-day.headline: Hamjakma salni hambai
occ.republic-day.message: Phaibaidi chwng chini constitution ni spirit tai India ni borok wngmani kung chukmung no palaibaidi. Jai Hind.
occ.independence-day.name: Swkangni sal
occ.independence-day.headline: Hamjakma salni hambai
occ.independence-day.message: Chwngno rwktharnai hero rok no hambai. Chini dopha teibo phan tei thansa wngwi tongthung. Jai Hind.
occ.gandhi-jayanti.name: Gandhi jayanti
occ.gandhi-jayanti.headline: Gandhi Jayanti ni Tongthok
occ.gandhi-jayanti.message: Dophani Buphano Muitu Khlaiwi. Bini kubui kok tei thwngmung kwrwi hwnwi uansukmarok chwngno jora jora khe lama phurwnai.
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.name: Ambedkar Jayanti
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.headline: Ambedkar jayanti ni sal no hambai
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.message: Chini Raida chayatwi swnamnai Dr. B. R. Ambedkar no khulumwi. Bini kwrwngma tei justice ni vision chwngno inspire khlai thung.
occ.kisan-diwas.name: Rajyo ni kheto khainai rok ni salo (kisan diwas)
occ.kisan-diwas.headline: Kisan Diwas ni Tongthok
occ.kisan-diwas.message: Chini dophani backbone chini kheto khainai rok no hambai. Chwng jotono chajak rwnai norok ni samung no hambai.
occ.teachers-day.name: Phwrwngnai rok ni sal
occ.teachers-day.headline: Teacher rok ni sal ni hambai
occ.teachers-day.message: Chwngno lama phurwmani bagwi, inspire khlaimanini bagwi tei chini bwskangni langmano swnammanini bagwi hambai. Teacher rokni sal ni hambai.
occ.childrens-day.name: Chwrai rok ni sal
occ.childrens-day.headline: Chwrai rok ni sal ni hambai
occ.childrens-day.message: Joto chwrairok ni tongthokma, majra kwrwi tei bwskangni rangchak no rwchapwi. Chwrai rok ni sal ni hambai.
occ.womens-day.name: Bwrwi rok ni sal
occ.womens-day.headline: Bwrwi rok ni sal ni hambai
occ.womens-day.message: Joto jagao bwrwirokni phan, khairokma tei thwngmungrokno khulumwi. Bwrwi rok ni sal no hambai.
occ.mothers-day.name: Buma ni sal
occ.mothers-day.headline: Buma ni sal ni hambai
occ.mothers-day.message: Patimung kwrwi hamjakma tei khá khárwi rwnai borokno — Buma ni salni hambai.
occ.fathers-day.name: Bupha ni sal
occ.fathers-day.headline: Tongthok Bupha ni Sal
occ.fathers-day.message: Chini phan tei lama phuarnai pillar no — Buphani salni hambai.
occ.doctors-day.name: Hasteni Doctors ni Sal
occ.doctors-day.headline: Doctor rok ni sal ni hambai
occ.doctors-day.message: Norokni saktharmung, uanama tei borokni bagwi seba khlaimanini bagwi hambai. Hasteni Doctors rokni salni hambai.
occ.friendship-day.name: Dophani Sal
occ.friendship-day.headline: Hamjakma salni hambai
occ.friendship-day.message: Hambai norok no belai kaham friend wngmani bagwi. Obo chini bond tei kwbangma khakchangma muitu.
occ.diwali.name: Diwali
occ.diwali.headline: Diwali ni hambai
occ.diwali.message: Pohorni panda norok tei norokni nukhungni borokrokno hamkrai, khakchangma tei hamya hamya wngwi tongthung.
occ.dhanteras.name: Dhanter rok
occ.dhanteras.headline: Dhantera ni Tongthok
occ.dhanteras.message: Lakshmi mwtai tei Bhagwan Dhanvantari nono rang-ri, hamkrai tei hamari rwthung.
occ.diwali-padwa.name: Diwali Padwa / Balipratipada
occ.diwali-padwa.headline: Diwali Padwa ni Hamjakma
occ.diwali-padwa.message: Hamjakma, khakchangma tei thwngmung bai supungjak kwtal kwtal wngwi tongna bagwi wish khlaio.
occ.bhai-dooj.name: Bhai Dooj / Bhaubeej .
occ.bhai-dooj.headline: Tongthok Bhai Dooj
occ.bhai-dooj.message: Takhuk bukhuk tei bukhukrokni bisingo tongnai kwthar bond no khulumwi. Hamjakma, mwthangmung tei khakchangma no wish khlaio.
occ.holi.name: Holi
occ.holi.headline: Holi ni hambai
occ.holi.message: Holi salni rangchakni rangchakrok nini langmano tongthokma, hamjakma tei rangchak bai supungwi rwthung.
occ.navratri.name: Navrasal
occ.navratri.headline: Navratri ni hambai
occ.navratri.message: Maa Durga norok no phan, buj thummung tei khakchangma rwthung o 9 jona jorao.
occ.dussehra.name: Dussehra sal
occ.dussehra.headline: Dusseh sal ni hambai
occ.dussehra.message: Kahamni hamyani sakao kwplai wngma bai norok bebak samungrokno thwngwi manna bagwi inspire wngwi tong thung.
occ.ganesh-chaturthi.name: Ganesh chati
occ.ganesh-chaturthi.headline: Ganesh salni hambai
occ.ganesh-chaturthi.message: Bhagwan Ganesha nini lama ni joto hamya no swkakwi nono buj thumnai tei rangchakni hamari rwthung. Ganpati bappa morya.
occ.raksha-bandhan.name: Raksha Bandhan
occ.raksha-bandhan.headline: Tongthok Raksha Bandhan
occ.raksha-bandhan.message: Takhuk bukhukrokni bisingo hamjakma tei mwthangjakmani naithokma bond no rwchapmung.
occ.janmashtami.name: janmashtami sal
occ.janmashtami.headline: Janmashtami ni hambai
occ.janmashtami.message: Subraiyung Krishna nini langmano hamjakma, khakchangma tei Kaitorni hamari bai supungwi rwthung.
occ.makar-sankranti.name: makkar sankran
occ.makar-sankranti.headline: Makar sankranti ni hambai
occ.makar-sankranti.message: O harvest panda nini langmao kwchangma, kwchangma tei rangchak tubuthung.
occ.maha-shivratri.name: Maha shivratri
occ.maha-shivratri.headline: Maha Shivratri ni Tongthok
occ.maha-shivratri.message: Lord Shiva norok no khakchangma, phan tei khakchangma rwthung. Har har mahadev.
occ.ram-navami.name: Ram nabami
occ.ram-navami.headline: Ram navami ni hambai
occ.ram-navami.message: Subrai Rama ni hamari norok no kubui, kaham tei khakchangma tubuthung.
occ.hanuman-jayanti.name: Hanuman Jayanti
occ.hanuman-jayanti.headline: Hanuman jayanti ni hambai
occ.hanuman-jayanti.message: Subraiyung Hanuman norok no sahorma, phan tei khatungma bai hamari rwthung.
occ.vasant-panchami.name: Samung panchami
occ.vasant-panchami.headline: Tongthok vasant panchami sal
occ.vasant-panchami.message: Saraswati mwtai norok no swrwngmung, rwngmung tei swnammung bai hamari rwthung.
occ.guru-purnima.name: guru purnima
occ.guru-purnima.headline: Guru purni ni sal no hambai
occ.guru-purnima.message: Sinimungni lama no pohor rwnai chini joto phwrwngnai tei mentors rok no hambai.
occ.akshaya-tritiya.name: Akshaya tritiya
occ.akshaya-tritiya.headline: Akshaya Tritiya ni Tongthok
occ.akshaya-tritiya.message: O kaham sal norokni bagwi paiphlaiya rangchak, thwngmung tei tongthokma tubuthung.
occ.karva-chauth.name: Karva sal
occ.karva-chauth.headline: Karva salni hambai
occ.karva-chauth.message: Hamjakma tei kwthalaimung bai supungjak Karva Chauth no hambai rwkha.
occ.chhath-puja.name: Chhath puja
occ.chhath-puja.headline: Chhath puja ni hambai
occ.chhath-puja.message: Chhathi Maiya tei Sun Kaitor nini tei nini nukhung no hamkrai tei hamari rwthung.
occ.nag-panchami.name: Nag panchami
occ.nag-panchami.headline: Khakchangha Nag panchami ni hambai
occ.nag-panchami.message: O kwthar sal norokni bagwi mwthangmung, khakchangma tei hamkrai tubuthung.
occ.tulsi-vivah.name: Tulsi langma
occ.tulsi-vivah.headline: Tulsi Vivah ni Tongthok
occ.tulsi-vivah.message: Tulsi tei Bhagwan Vishnu ni divine union norokni nogo khakchangma tei khakchangma rwthung.
occ.eid-ul-fitr.name: Fitr sal
occ.eid-ul-fitr.headline: Eid mubarak
occ.eid-ul-fitr.message: O Eid norok tei norokni hamjakma borok rok no khakchangma, khakchangma tei hamari tubuthung.
occ.eid-ul-adha.name: Eid al-adha (bakrid)
occ.eid-ul-adha.headline: Eid al-adha mubarak
occ.eid-ul-adha.message: Allah ni hamari norokni langmano khakchangma bai supungwi rwthung tei jotono thwngmungni dugar phiyogwi rwthung.
occ.milad-un-nabi.name: Milad-un-nabi
occ.milad-un-nabi.headline: Eid milad-un-nabi mubarak
occ.milad-un-nabi.message: O hamari sal nini bwkhao khakchangma, hamjakma tei khairokma bai supungjak thung.
occ.christmas.name: Krismas
occ.christmas.headline: Krismas ni hambai
occ.christmas.message: Hamjakma, khakchangma tei khakchangma bai supungjak Christmas, tei bwskango kaham khe tongna bagwi wish khlaio.
occ.easter.name: Istar
occ.easter.headline: Easter ni hambai
occ.easter.message: Easter ni tongthokma tei khatungma norokni bwkha tei nogo supungwi tong thung.
occ.guru-nanak-jayanti.name: Guru nanak jayanti (Gurpurab)
occ.guru-nanak-jayanti.headline: Gurpurab ni Tongthok
occ.guru-nanak-jayanti.message: Guru Nanak Dev Ji ni phwrwngmung norok no khakchangma, kubui tei khairokma lamao tubuthung.
occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.name: Guru gobind singh jayanti
occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.headline: Guru gobind singh jayanti no kha kaham bai hambai
occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.message: Guru Gobind Singh Ji ni sahorma tei buj thummung chwng jotono khatungwi tongthung.
occ.buddha-purnima.name: Buda purnima
occ.buddha-purnima.headline: Tongthok Budha Purnima ni Sal
occ.buddha-purnima.message: Buddha Buddha ni phwrwngmungrok nini langmao khakchangma, khairokma tei rwngthoma tubuthung.
occ.mahavir-jayanti.name: mahavir jayanti
occ.mahavir-jayanti.headline: Mahavir jayanti ni sal no hambai
occ.mahavir-jayanti.message: Subrai Mahavir ni phwrwngmungrok non-violence tei kubui kok norok ni langmao khakchangma tubuthung.
occ.paryushan.name: Paryusan / Samvatsari
occ.paryushan.headline: Michhami Dukham
occ.paryushan.message: Ang norokno mungsa swk khe, saimanwi eba saimanyawi, uansukma bai, kok bai eba samung bai hamya khlai khe, ang norokni nakarmung sanwi tongo.
occ.navroz.name: Parsi bisi kwtal(Navroz) 2018 bisi kwtal.
occ.navroz.headline: Navroz mubark
occ.navroz.message: Norokno khakchangma, hamya hamya tei rangchak bai supungjak Parsi bisi kwtal wngwi tongna bagwi wish khlaio.
occ.lohri.name: Lohri
occ.lohri.headline: Lohri ni hambai
occ.lohri.message: Lohri bonfire ni rangchak bai tongthokma, rangchak tei kwbangma rangchak tubunai.
occ.baisakhi.name: Baisakhi
occ.baisakhi.headline: Tongthok Baisakhi
occ.baisakhi.message: O harvest sal nini langma no kwbangma, tongthokma tei rangchak bai supung thung.
occ.teej.name: Hariyali teej
occ.teej.headline: Teej ni hambai
occ.teej.message: Devi Parvati norok no hamjakma, khakchangma tei hamari rwthung.
occ.gudi-padwa.name: Gudi padwa
occ.gudi-padwa.headline: Tongthok Gudi Padwa
occ.gudi-padwa.message: O Marathi bisi kwtal norokni bagwi kwtal khatungma, thwngmung tei thwngmung tubuthung.
occ.ugadi.name: Ugadi
occ.ugadi.headline: Ugadi ni hambai
occ.ugadi.message: O bisi kwtal norokni bagwi kaham khe tongthokma, hamya tei hamya wngwi phaithung.
occ.cheti-chand.name: Cheti chand
occ.cheti-chand.headline: Cheti Chand ni Tongthok
occ.cheti-chand.message: Sindhi Bisi kwtal o Jhulelal nono hamari, hamari tei charimung rwthung.
occ.puthandu.name: Puthandu (Tamil bisi kwtal)
occ.puthandu.headline: Tamil bisi kwtal ni hambai
occ.puthandu.message: O Tamil bisi kwtal norokni bagwi khakchangma, rangchak tei kotor kotor thwngmung tubuthung.
occ.vishu.name: Bishu
occ.vishu.headline: Hambai Vishu
occ.vishu.message: O Vishu norokni bagwi bisi kaisa rangchak, khakchangma tei rangchakni hamari tubuthung.
occ.pohela-boishakh.name: Pohela boishakh (bengali bisi kwtal) (bengali bisi kwtal).
occ.pohela-boishakh.headline: Shubho Noboborsho
occ.pohela-boishakh.message: Bengali bisi kwtal no khakchangma, thwngmung tei rangchak bai kupulung wngna bagwi wish khwlaio.
occ.bohag-bihu.name: Bohag bihu (rongali bihu) .
occ.bohag-bihu.headline: Tongthok Bohag Bihu
occ.bohag-bihu.message: O Rongali Bihu norokni langmao tongthokma kwtal, khatungma kwtal tei hamari tubuthung.
occ.magh-bihu.name: Magh bihu (bhogali bihu) .
occ.magh-bihu.headline: Tongthok Magh Bihu
occ.magh-bihu.message: Magh Bihu ni rangchakni panda norokni nogo kwbangma manwi tei tongthokma tubuthung.
occ.pongal.name: Pongal
occ.pongal.headline: Pongal ni Tongthok
occ.pongal.message: O Pongal norokni bagwi khakchangma, hamya tei hamya wngwi tongthung.
occ.uttarayan.name: Uttarayan (Kwplaisa panda)
occ.uttarayan.headline: Uttarayan ni Tongthok
occ.uttarayan.message: Nini success chuknohani rangchakni rangchak hai khe kotor wngwi tongthung.
occ.onam.name: Onam
occ.onam.headline: Onam ni hambai
occ.onam.message: Raja Mahabali norokni nogo hamari, tongthokma tei thansa wngthung.
occ.durga-puja.name: Durga puja
occ.durga-puja.headline: Shubho Durga Puja .
occ.durga-puja.message: Maa Durga norokni sakao bini phan, khakchangma tei rangchakni hamari rwthung.
occ.kali-puja.name: Kali puja
occ.kali-puja.headline: Kali puja ni chibai
occ.kali-puja.message: Maa Kali nono bebak hamya ni yakni mwthangwi tonw tei phan tei khakchangma rwthung.
occ.rath-yatra.name: Rath Yatra
occ.rath-yatra.headline: Rath Yatra ni Tongthok
occ.rath-yatra.message: Lord Jagannath nini tei nini nukhung no hamari tei hamari kupthung. Jai Jagannath.
occ.raja-parba.name: Raja parba
occ.raja-parba.headline: Tongthok Raja Parba
occ.raja-parba.message: Buma Swngchar tei Monsoon phaimani salno khulumwi. Norokno khakchangma tei hamari rwna bagwi wish khlaio.
occ.nuakhai.name: Nukhai
occ.nuakhai.headline: Nukhai Juhar
occ.nuakhai.message: O rangchakni panda norokni langmano kwbangma manwi bai tei tongthokma bai supungwi rw thung.
occ.bathukamma.name: Bathukamma
occ.bathukamma.headline: Bathukamma ni Tongthok
